name: Account Identity Provider Abstraction
description: Abstract over identity providers (GitHub, Google, SSO, local) with a common interface. Each provider returns a normalized identity payload that the account system consumes uniformly.
purpose: Enable pluggable identity providers without coupling the account system to any specific auth backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Common IdentityProvider interface defined with providerId, auth, verify, and profile methods
Local provider adapter wrapping local principal model
All adapters produce a normalized identity payload with deterministic account binding
